headline: SpaceX reportedly explores buying or partnering with Boost Mobile
summary: SpaceX is reportedly looking at either buying Boost Mobile or using its cellular network, a move that could give Starlink terrestrial access and establish SpaceX as a mobile carrier competing with AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon. The two reports agree on the substance of the talks.

claims.statement: SpaceX is reportedly exploring a deal with Boost Mobile, possibly buying it or using its cellular network.

sources.quote: SpaceX reportedly wants to buy Boost Mobile to compete with AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon
SpaceX is reportedly looking at buying Boost Mobile or using its cell network

claims.statement: A tie-up with Boost Mobile could give SpaceX terrestrial cellular access and establish it as a mobile carrier.
